findings.highlight: You're a Matou woman. A lowly, cowardly has-been of a mage, no different from an emotionless doll!"
findings.evidenceJa: おまえは間桐の女だ。卑しい魔術師くずれ、恐れ、怯え、やがて感情をなくし人形と変わらなくなる！」
findings.governingReading: Abusive taunt: fear, trembling, eventually losing feeling until no different from doll.
findings.explanation: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.

findings.highlight: The man who had been bearing down on her limps over.
findings.evidenceJa: 圧し掛かっていた男が倒れる。
findings.governingReading: Man bearing down falls/collapses when shadow strikes; immediately dead next page.

findings.highlight: The girl rises and looks wordlessly at the man.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女は体を起こして、物言わぬ兄を見つめた。
findings.governingReading: Girl raises body and looks at silent/non-speaking brother, cue of collapse.
findings.explanation: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.

findings.highlight: Something incredibly sharp hit him in the head,
findings.evidenceJa: ものすごく鋭利なヒモで、ぱしん、と頭を叩かれたのだろう。
findings.governingReading: Seems head hit with extremely sharp string/thread, inferred from pencil-like fine wound and brain depth.
findings.explanation: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.

findings.highlight: "...Oh. Looks like I've been slowly going crazy all along."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—なんだ。少しずつおかしくなってたんじゃないんだ」
findings.governingReading: She realizes it wasn't gradually going wrong, next asserts broken from outset.
findings.explanation: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.

findings.highlight: There's someone else she's speaking to, as well.
findings.evidenceJa: その少女に語りかけるものがある。
findings.governingReading: There is something addressing girl, then Zouken voice behind.
findings.explanation: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.

findings.highlight: All she knows is that the moment she accepted her shadow, all the pain she'd ever felt vanished like a dream.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、受け入れた途端、あれだけ苦しかった体が嘘のように楽になった。
findings.governingReading: Upon acceptance current terribly suffering body becomes miraculously easy.
findings.explanation: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.

findings.highlight: Starting with her feet, the black mud coats her skin.
findings.evidenceJa: 体の芯から、黒い泥が肌を塗りたくっていく。
findings.governingReading: Black mud from core/interior of body coats skin.
findings.explanation: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.

findings.highlight: She'll defeat everyone who's threatened her, just as she always imagined.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
findings.governingReading: She defeats those who threatened her within present imagination; next joy in imagined acts.
findings.explanation: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.
